title: VALUES returns one BLANK when the column stores a BLANK and the table has the blank row

source.quote: VALUES includes the blank row caused by an invalid relationship, if present
If a relationship is invalid, the VertiPaq engine automatically adds a row containing BLANK in every column of the table on the one-side of the relationship
source.supports: the blank row's Color is BLANK

derivation: Stored values: Red, Blue, BLANK (Bell). The blank row adds a BLANK, which is the same value as the stored one. VALUES of a column returns unique values: 3 rows, not 4.
